body.name: Shared-response factual and counterfactual trajectories
body.construction: Draw \(X_0\sim\rho\), set \(Z_0=X_0\), draw \(F_t\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}q\), and recursively set \(X_t=F_t(X_{t-1},b(X_{t-1}))\) and \(Z_t=F_t(Z_{t-1},\pi(Z_{t-1}))\) for \(t=1,\ldots,T\); report \(E_T=(o(X_0),\ldots,o(X_T))\).
